violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: The sink basin at the service area is slow to drain.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. EHS discussed with PIC repairing the sink drain/plumbing to ensure proper drainage.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Restriction & Storage; Medicines Location
violations.observation: Employees' medicines are not properly located to prevent contamination of food and food contact surfaces. Observed employees’ medication stored among food on a kitchen shelf.
violations.corrective_action: Employees' medicines shall be properly stored to prevent contamination of food and food contact surfaces. PIC relocated employees’ medication to the designated area.

violations.title: Hair Restraints
violations.observation: Employees observed working in the food service area without proper hair restraints.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall wear hair restraints such as hats, visors, hair nets or beard nets to effectively keep their hair from contacting exposed food, clean equipment, utensils, linens, and unwrapped single-service items. This section does not apply to food employees such as counter staff who ONLY serve beverages and wrapped or packaged foods, hostesses, and wait staff. PIC provided employees with proper hair restraints.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Dead or Trapped Pest Removed
violations.observation: Dead or trapped roaches were found on the premis. Observed glue boards with dead roaches that need to be discarded.
violations.corrective_action: Remove dead rodents, birds, and insects from the premises to ensure that the establishment is clean and sanitary and to prevent carcasses from attracting other pests. EHS instructed the manager to have more frequent pest control services and to have them remove the glue boards with dead roaches to prevent the attraction of others. PIC discarded the blu boards traps with dead roaches.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed that the ceiling panels in the kitchen is not maintained in good repair. Observed small gaps in the panels above AO Smith water heater.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. EHS discussed sealing up any small gaps in the panels where electrical wiring is located. PIC will email proof of the repairs.

violations.title: Non-TCS Food Contact Surface, Clean per Manufacturer
violations.observation: Exterior and exterior surfaces of ice machine are not being cleaned as required.
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces of utensils and equipment contacting food that is NOT time/temperature control for safety food such as ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment such as ice makers, cooking oil storage tanks and distribution lines, beverage and syrup dispensing lines or tubes, coffee bean grinders, and water vending equipment at a frequency specified by the manufacturer or at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil or mold. PIC cleaned and sanitized ice machine surfaces during the inspection.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Plumbing connection under the 3 compartment is leaking.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. PIC contacted a technician during the inspection.

violations.title: Where to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee was observed cleaning their hands in a food preparation sink, warewashing sink or in a mop sink. EHS observed employee washing hands in prep sink at the back of the kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands in ONLY a designated handsink. PIC corrected employee on where to wash hands and to not use prep sink as a handwashing sink

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: Manufacturer containers were observed reused for the storage of Cinnamon , all spice, cornstarch, flour, sugar.
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. PIC agreed to not re-use containers and to acquire new approved reusable containers by next inspection
